title: Department of Electrical Engineering, IIT Kharagpur - Shaping Future Innovators in Electrical Engineering since 1951
description:
Overview:
The Department of Electrical Engineering at IIT Kharagpur is one of the oldest and most dynamic academic units of the institute. We offer undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs that are designed to create leaders in research, industry, and public service. 🎓 Programs Offered Undergraduate: B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, B.Tech in Instrumentation Engineering Opportunities for double majors, minors, and semester-long industry/university internships Postgraduate: M.S. and M.Tech. Five M.Tech specializations Postgraduate Research (PhD): PhD in the 5 specializations ⚡Specializations: 1. Machine Drives and Power Electronics 2. Control Systems 3. Power and Energy Systems 4. Instrumentation and Intgrated Electronics 5. Signal Processing and Machine Learning 📘 Curriculum Highlights Our curriculum is continuously updated to reflect the latest advancements in electrical sciences and technology. Areas of expertise include: Electrical machines, power electronics, power systems, control systems, analog and digital electronics, VLSI, optimization models and algorithms, AI/ML, digital signal processing, embedded systems, principles of communication engineering, fundamentals of electronic materials, basic mathematics and physics, programming and data structure and many more. 🌍 Global Opportunities & Alumni Network Our alumni excel across the world in research, entrepreneurship, and leadership roles, creating a strong global network. Explore their success stories here: https://ee.iitkgp.ac.in/alumni_award We invite you to explore our programs, connect with our vibrant community, and join us in shaping the future of electrical engineering. 🔗 More About Us Visit our website for details on research, academics, and departmental activities.
